title: •Admiral Ozzel
caption: •Admiral Ozzel (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}. While piloting a capital starship at a battleground system, in each battle a player’s first battle destiny draw may not be canceled or reduced and if opponent canceled a just drawn battle destiny, they lose 1 Force.
lore: Leader of the Emperor’s Death Squadron assigned to hunt down and crush the Rebellion. As clumsy as he is stupid. Has just failed Darth Vader for the next-to-last time.
copyright: TM & © 1996 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1996 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Stats POWER 3 / ABILITY 2, third box printed blank; deploy 2 / forfeit 4 (printed 0/4). Leading yellow DS pilot-power icon + '2.' → {pilot:2} (stub: 'Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots'). Curly apostrophe in player’s. Icon column: pilot (yellow DS helmet) only. Imperial (Imperial disc top-left on the scans). The wiki's default 'Admiral Ozzel' page carries Glossary Supplement errata text; printed face = 'Admiral Ozzel (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set). The 745 px Hoth-D-admiralozzel.gif is the D-E1 errata face — downloaded to src/vs14/17-Hoth-D-admiralozzel.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan (square-on, 350×490) is the printed face used as src. Lore corrected from scan: curly apostrophe in Emperor’s (wiki straight). 'Leader' is bold on the 745 errata face but plain on the printed archive scan → left unbolded (renderer bolds keywords itself). Copyright 1996 legible on the 745 face. Modern: V13-D-admiralozzel.gif (745 px) is the PC's later Virtual Set 13 Admiral Ozzel (V) (different text) — art backport only; VB2 -pre (350, this slip reissued) also exists, not kept.
